origin.description: The option readr.num_threads wins. Otherwise the VROOM_THREADS environment variable, then the CPU count.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: The option readr.num_threads wins. Otherwise the VROOM_THREADS environment variable, then the CPU count.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
old <- options(readr.num_threads = 4)
on.exit(options(old), add = TRUE)
as.character(readr_threads())
